title: MOSAIC: Modular Orchestration for Structured Agentic Intelligence and Composition

claim.summary: MOSAIC constructs executable modelling workflows from retrieved cases and code modules, then uses execution diagnostics and a separately trained RL policy for failure-aware refinement.

tasks.source_label: Forecasting and prediction; Augmentation and synthesis

modules.name: Repository-grounded blueprint composition
modules.scope_reason: Retrieving code and cases, composing module interfaces and realizing a blueprint are general workflow-construction mechanisms.

modules.name: Failure-aware code-refinement policy
modules.scope_reason: Checkpoint rollback, trajectory branching and invalid-action masks operate on code execution and diagnostic states without temporal-specific semantics.
evidence_locators: PDF p.6; passage beginning "Offline trajectory construction."

modules.name: Temporal statistical and visual task profiling
modules.scope_reason: ADF results, temporal plots and regime summaries ground model selection across forecasting and generation.
